text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand and work with human language. One of its main tasks is text understanding, where machines pick out the meaning and structure from written words. NLP is also used in translation tools, allowing people to read documents or messages in their own language. Another common application is sentiment analysis, which identifies whether a piece of text sounds positive, negative, or neutral, often used by companies to gauge customer opinions. Finally, chatbots rely on NLP to have natural conversations with users, answering questions and providing support in a helpful way.
